member.name: T:Sdcb.OpenVINO.Extensions.OpenCvSharp4.MatExtensions
member.summary: Provides extension methods for the class.

member.name: M:Sdcb.OpenVINO.Extensions.OpenCvSharp4.MatExtensions.WeakRef(OpenCvSharp.Mat)
member.summary: Returns a weak reference to the specified object. This method does not support Sub-matrix (ROI).
member.remarks: Note: This method has been marked as obsolete due to its inability to handle ROIs correctly. When src is a ROI, the Mat returned from this function will be incorrect.
member.param: The Mat object to create a weak reference to.
member.returns: A weak reference to the specified Mat object.

member.name: M:Sdcb.OpenVINO.Extensions.OpenCvSharp4.MatExtensions.FastClone(OpenCvSharp.Mat)
member.summary: Creates a clone of the specified object. The clone shares the same memory space as the original Mat object.
member.remarks: Please note that write modifications or setting ROIs on either the new Mat or the original Mat may affect each other, as they share the same memory space.
member.returns: A clone of the specified Mat object.

member.name: M:Sdcb.OpenVINO.Extensions.OpenCvSharp4.MatExtensions.Padding(OpenCvSharp.Mat,System.Int32,System.Nullable{OpenCvSharp.Scalar})
member.summary: Adds padding around a given image.
member.param: Source image to apply padding to, represented as an OpenCvSharp4 Mat.
Optional parameter specifying the padding size. Default value is 32.
Optional parameter specifying the color of the padding. Default value is black.
member.returns: Returns a new image with padding. If the source image size is already a multiple of the padding size, a weak reference to the original image is returned to save memory. Otherwise, the function creates a new image with the appropriate size, copies the source image into it, and fills in the additional space with the specified color.

member.name: M:Sdcb.OpenVINO.Extensions.OpenCvSharp4.MatExtensions.StackingVertically(OpenCvSharp.Mat[],System.Int32,System.Int32)
member.summary: Stacks an array of Mats into a single Mat by placing them vertically. The resulted Mat is made by vertically stacking the input Mats, each having the same type and specified height and width.
member.param: An array of Mats that are to be stacked. It's assumed that all provided Mats are having the same type.
The desired height for each Mat. All Matrices should have the same height.
The desired width for all Matrices. This width will also apply to resulted stacked Mat.
member.returns: Returns a new Mat that is a vertical stack of all input Mats, each having the specified height and width.
member.exception: Thrown when srcs is null or empty, or when any of the Mats in srcs does not match the specified type.
member.remarks: This method utilizes OpenCvSharp4 for operations on Mats. Pay attention to match correctly the type of Mats in the 'srcs' array.

member.name: M:Sdcb.OpenVINO.Extensions.OpenCvSharp4.MatExtensions.StackingVertically(OpenCvSharp.Mat[])
member.summary: Stacks an array of Mats into a single Mat by placing them vertically. This version of StackingVertically is optimized for speed and requires the Mats to have the same width.
member.param: An array of Mats that are to be stacked. All Mats must have the same width and type.
member.returns: Returns a new Mat that is a vertical stack of all input Mats.
member.exception: Thrown when the Mats within srcs have differing widths.
member.remarks: This method is an optimized version of vertical stacking where it is assumed that all Mats have the same width. It straightly stacks the Mats in the given order, therefore the widths must be consistent to avoid issues.
